clinical_intent: I need to understand the role of artificial intelligence in automatic organ-at-risk delineation for brachytherapy. How accurate are current AI algorithms for OAR segmentation in the pelvis? What are the clinical requirements for AI-based OAR delineation? How should I validate AI-generated contours before using them in brachytherapy planning? What are the current limitations?
